lines.beaver: 오늘 시금치 나물 만들 거야. 어떻게 해?
lines.beaver_en: We're making spinach namul today. How do you do it?
lines.beaver_roman: oneul sigeumchi namul mandeul geoya. eotteoke hae?
lines.learner: 끓는 물에 살짝 데치면 되던데. 오래 하면 안 돼.
lines.en: I found you just blanch it lightly in boiling water. Not too long.
lines.roman: kkeulleun mure saljjak dechimyeon doedeonde. orae hamyeon an dwae.

lines.beaver_en: Why? What happens if you blanch it too long?
lines.learner: 해 보니까 색이 나빠지던데. 맛도 별로였어.
lines.en: When I tried, the color got worse. It didn't taste good either.
lines.roman: hae bonikka saegi nappajideonde. matdo byeolloyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. What do you put in the seasoning?
lines.learner: 마늘이랑 파를 조금 넣으면 꽤 맛있던데.
lines.en: Adding a little garlic and green onion made it pretty tasty.
lines.roman: manurirang pareul jogeum neoeumyeon kkwae masitdeonde.

lines.beaver_en: What about the saltiness? Lots of salt?
lines.learner: 아니, 조금씩 넣고 맛보면서 맞추면 되던데.
lines.en: No, I found you just add a little at a time and taste as you go.
lines.roman: ani, jogeumssik neoko matbomyeonseo matchumyeon doedeonde.

lines.learner: 멸치는 머리를 떼고 볶으면 덜 쓰던데.
lines.en: Anchovies were less bitter when I removed the heads first.
lines.roman: myeolchineun meorireul ttego bokkeumyeon deol sseudeonde.

lines.beaver_en: We're making soup too. Should we add red pepper powder?
lines.learner: 응, 고추 하나랑 고춧가루를 넣으면 시원하던데.
lines.en: Yeah, with one red pepper and pepper powder it tasted refreshing.
lines.roman: eung, gochu hanarang gochutgarureul neoeumyeon siwonhadeonde.

lines.beaver_en: Should we peel the potatoes before boiling?
lines.en: I found the skin comes off easier if you boil them whole.

lines.beaver_en: Then what should we put on the potatoes?
lines.learner: 버터랑 치즈 올리고 후추 뿌리면 맛있던데.
lines.en: Butter and cheese on top with pepper sprinkled was delicious.
lines.roman: beoteorang chijeu olligo huchu ppurimyeon masitdeonde.

lines.beaver_en: Sounds tasty! We have cabbage too. What should we do?
lines.learner: 양배추는 밥솥 찜 기능으로 찌면 편하던데.
lines.en: Steaming cabbage with the rice cooker's steam function was easy.
lines.roman: yangbaechuneun bapsot jjim gineungeuro jjimyeon pyeonhadeonde.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 다 됐다! 물 좀 따라 줄래?
lines.beaver_en: Great. All done! Can you pour some water?
lines.beaver_roman: joa. da dwaetda! mul jom ttara jullae?
lines.learner: 응, 물 따라 줄게. 이제 맛있게 먹자!
lines.en: Sure, I'll pour it. Now let's enjoy!
lines.roman: eung, mul ttara julge. ije masitge meokja!
